findings.title: Timeout kill tests assert nothing about SIGKILL or process exit
findings.problem: The SIGTERM-ignoring child test only awaits the rejection and sleeps without asserting the child was killed, and is skipped on Windows. No test covers a child holding stdout open not keeping the process alive, which is the AC6 mechanism required by the spec's test list.
findings.impact: The core hardening (SIGKILL escalation, pipe destroy, unref) can regress with all tests green; the user requested unit tests for this behavior.
findings.recommendation: Assert the child is actually dead after the grace period (pid liveness check) and add a stdout-holding-child test; avoid vacuous skips where feasible.
findings.check_notes: exec.test.ts asserts killed child pid is dead (SIGKILL after grace) and a stdout-holding child does not keep the call pending; no platform skip.

fix.change: exec tests now assert killed child pid is dead and stdout-holding child does not keep call pending

findings.title: Windows shell wrapper kill may orphan grandchild
findings.problem: With shell:true on Windows, the timeout kill targets only the shell wrapper, so a grandchild version process may survive.
findings.impact: Orphaned process lingers, but pipes are destroyed and child unref'd so the CLI still exits; trigger limited to shell-spawned probes on Windows.
findings.recommendation: Consider taskkill /T /F on win32 when shell is used.

findings.title: closeStdin alone triggers kill hardening
findings.problem: terminate() runs when closeStdin OR killGraceMs is set, so closeStdin alone destroys pipes and unrefs on timeout; spec ties this to killGraceMs.
findings.impact: No current caller sets closeStdin without killGraceMs, so no behavior consequence today.
findings.recommendation: Key the hardening on killGraceMs or document the intent.

fix.change: exec timeout kill hardening keyed on killGraceMs alone; closeStdin only changes stdin stdio
fix.test: src/utils/__tests__/exec.test.ts (closeStdin alone keeps plain kill on timeout; killGraceMs enables pipe release)
